item.title: Person Refuses To Justify Their Disability To Unhinged Karen Who Demanded Their Parking Spot
item.description: While old age warrants respect, it does not give anyone the right to misuse that privilege. But of course, you will still have those who will try to make the most out of being an elderly person in the worst possible way. This old woman is an example of that, as she tried to bully a handicapped person into moving parking spots.

item.title: Manager Insists On Making Comments About Man’s Weight, Gets A Reply He Didn’t Expect
item.description: He says he's happy, healthy and merely "presents" as skinny. But his boss won't stop commenting on his weight (or lack thereof). So this guy decided to dish up a plate of petty revenge, and proceeded to serve it ice cold. The mood in the office immediately became awkward...

item.title: 81 Times People Hilariously Owned Themselves By Incorrectly Correcting Others
item.description: We’ve all seen it online… someone confidently correcting a joke, a fact, or even your grammar, only to be completely wrong themselves. Sometimes, people think they know more than they do, and they are only encouraged by social media’s reach and anonymity. But a Facebook page is exposing all these incorrect correctors, and we just can’t help but laugh at how overconfident some people can be.

item.title: 56 Times A Date Went South Really Fast
item.description: If you're an introvert, you've probably heard at some point in your life to just "get over yourself" and go talk to that person you've been stealing glances at because, after all, "What's the worst thing that can happen?" Well, surprise, surprise, a lot of things! One internet user asked everyone to describe the most messed-up date they've been on, and the replies that came in make singlehood sound like a blessing. item.title: “Would You Choose Immortality Knowing The Cost?”: Vote On 29 Power Dilemmas
item.description: Would you always find parking, but it’s never close to your destination?This poll is full of dilemmas like that. There are 29 different scenarios where every wish, power, or life upgrade comes with a downside that’s hard to ignore. Maybe you could become insanely rich overnight, but never know whether people love you or your money.
